name: cursor-bridge
description: Drive Cursor IDE agents over CDP for semantic search, policy-controlled bounded delegation, and safe top-level Agent parallelism.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work to Cursor with session policies and safe Agent parallelism.
interface.longDescription: Expose cursor_search, cursor_status, cursor_policy, cursor_launch, and—unless CURSOR_BRIDGE_DELEGATION=off—cursor_do. Session policies from off through eager control delegation aggressiveness rather than call frequency. Cursor Bridge retains FIFO compatibility or submits independent bounded tasks to separate top-level Cursor Agents, tracks them by stable agent ID, and collects each result without using Cursor /multitask.
defaultPrompt: Use Cursor Bridge to search this project with Cursor's semantic agent.
Use cursor_policy and cursor_status to honor the effective session delegation policy; active is the recommended default, auto is cautious, and eager maximizes safe bounded parallelism.

When policy permits and cursor_do is available, proactively delegate a bounded task with clear purpose, scope, invariants, and acceptance checks, allow limited local investigation, then collect it through cursor_status and verify the real result.
When cursor_do is available, submit independent non-overlapping tasks as separate top-level Cursor Agents and collect them by task ID; otherwise keep execution in the main agent.
